description: This file contains network interface utility functions for Linux, including interface existence checks, IP address retrieval and setting, MAC address handling, interface state management, softwds creation, listing interfaces, and PPPoE management.

methods.name: os_nif_exists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface exists by retrieving its index.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_get
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_netmask_get
methods.description: Retrieves the netmask of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_bcast_get
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast address of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_set
methods.description: Sets the IPv4 address of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_netmask_set
methods.description: Sets the netmask of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_bcast_set
methods.description: Sets the broadcast address of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_mtu_get
methods.description: Retrieves the MTU of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_mtu_set
methods.description: Sets the MTU of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_get
methods.description: Alias for os_nif_macaddr.

methods.name: os_nif_macaddr_set
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_gateway_set
methods.description: Sets the default gateway for a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_gateway_del
methods.description: Deletes the default gateway for a specified interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ipaddr_from_str
methods.description: Converts a string IPv4 address to os_ipaddr_t type.

methods.name: os_nif_up
methods.description: Brings an interface up or down.

methods.name: os_nif_is_up
methods.description: Checks if an interface is up.

methods.name: os_nif_is_running
methods.description: Checks if an interface is operational (running).

methods.name: os_nif_softwds_create
methods.description: Creates a softwds link on a parent interface.

methods.name: os_nif_softwds_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a softwds link.

methods.name: os_nif_list_get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of network interfaces from /proc/net/dev.

methods.name: os_nif_list_free
methods.description: Frees a list of network interfaces.

methods.name: os_nif_ifreq
methods.description: Prepares an ioctl request for network interface.

methods.name: os_nif_ioctl
methods.description: Performs an ioctl system call for network interface requests.

methods.name: os_nif_pppoe_pidof
methods.description: Retrieves the PID of the PPPoE process for an interface.

methods.name: os_nif_pppoe_start
methods.description: Starts PPPoE service on an interface.

methods.name: os_nif_pppoe_stop
methods.description: Stops PPPoE service on an interface.

methods.name: os_nif_is_interface_ready
methods.description: Checks if an interface exists and is operational.
